item.title: Daily Digest · Tue Oct 6 — DW735X Planer & Home-Shop Deals
item.description:
DeWalt DW735X planer $659 (save $200), Rockler Rock-Steady outfeed kit, WoodRiver front vise, Razorsaw dovetail saw, Milwaukee M18 FUEL PACKOUT vac free-battery promo, plus a front-vise mounting tip.

  • DEWALT DW735X 13" 2-Speed Planer — $659 (list $859) · Rockler
  • Rockler Rock-Steady Knock-Down Table Saw Outfeed Kit — $89.99 (list $134.99)
  • WoodRiver Front Vise, Small — $71.99 (list $119.99) · Woodcraft
  • Razorsaw Dovetail Saw 240mm No.311 — $29.99 (list $59.99) · Woodcraft
  • Milwaukee M18 FUEL PACKOUT Wet/Dry Vac — free battery promo (confirm at checkout)

Build tip: Bolt the mounting plate through the bench top into a solid apron or cleat—not just into thin plywood.
